title: TruPASS: From Position Paper to Research Programme
subtitle: Regen Studio joins a four-year NWO-funded consortium to build trust into Digital Product Passports
author: Yvo Hunink de Paiva
imageAlt: TruPASS — building trust ecosystems for Digital Product Passports across European supply chains
description: Regen Studio joins the TruPASS consortium as partner and project manager — a four-year, EUR 2.5 million NWO-funded research programme building trust into Digital Product Passports, starting from hydrogen passports and extending to container logistics and ESG reporting.
